tagline.en: Turn your Android phone into a classic mobile phone and play J2ME games.
tagline.vi: Turn your Android phone into a classic mobile phone and play J2ME games.

about.en: Bring back the feel of classic mobile phones with Java Pocket. Explore a collection of retro handset designs, then run compatible J2ME games in a nostalgic phone interface with an on-screen keypad. Import your own J2ME game files in .jar format, choose a phone model, and use familiar controls such as the D-pad, number keys, and soft keys. You can also adjust the screen size for each imported game and keep your favourites close at hand. Features
